transcript:
maria: FYI, escalation from ACME — they say Feb 22 invoice is ~40% lower than their dashboard export. Ticket #6529.
support-liz: Got the CSV and dashboard screenshots. Their reported window: 2026-02-22 ~02:00-03:30 UTC.
dina-billing: Checking ledger + invoice now, pulling raw billed tokens. Standby.
devin: Quick scan of metering ingestion shows a consumer pause in the event-store around 02:12-03:06 UTC — looks like a gap. Could explain missing tokens.
data-ryan: Query I ran to show the gap:
```
SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) as minute, count(*) AS events
FROM raw_events
WHERE received_at >= '2026-02-22 01:45:00+00' AND received_at < '2026-02-22 04:00:00+00'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```
Results show near-zero events between 2026-02-22 02:12 and 03:05 UTC.
ashok: Consumer process (ingest-consumer-1) was OOM-killed at 02:11 UTC, k8s restarted but backlog replay failed to write to processed-topic due to a proto schema mismatch. Logs show error.
devin: snippet from replay logs:
```
ERROR: proto: unknown field "token_estimate_v2" in event payload
at replay/worker.go:412
```
sre-jordan: That proto change was rolled out on 2026-02-20 (PR #428) — it added token_estimate_v2 but replay tool expects v1 shape. We didn't add a compatibility shim.
data-ryan: So the ingestion resumed but replay/backfill step errored and never marked events as processed -> ledger never saw those tokens.
dina-billing: OK that explains lower invoice numbers. What's our plan to recover and reconcile? Customer wants numbers and a fix asap.
devin: Proposed plan: apply a lightweight transform during replay to translate v2 -> v1 fields, then run controlled backfill for the affected window. Steps: create transform script, run replay-tool with controlled concurrency + throttling, validate sums, then update ledger.
maria: Who can own the transform + replay run? Need ETA and risk notes for customer.
data-ryan: I'll own validation and diff checks. devin or ashok can own the transform + execution.
ashok: I'll open a patch branch now: fix/replay-proto-compat. Transform will map token_estimate_v2 -> token_estimate and copy fields. Small snippet:
```
# transform_v2_to_v1.py
def transform(event):
    if 'token_estimate_v2' in event:
        event['token_estimate'] = event.pop('token_estimate_v2')
    return event
```
devin: Patch pushed, CI green on unit tests for transform. Plan to run replay-tool like:
```
replay-tool replay \
  --job-window "2026-02-22T02:00:00Z/2026-02-22T03:30:00Z" \
  --transform-script transform_v2_to_v1.py \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --throttle 250 \
  --target-topic processed-events
```
sre-jordan: Sound good. Keep concurrency low until we validate. Also pin to dedicated replay workers to avoid impacting hosted runtime.
replay-bot: Job created: id=rb-20260222-001, window=2026-02-22T02:00:00Z/2026-02-22T03:30:00Z, owner=devin. Status=queued.
devin: Kicked off replay job now. Monitoring output.
replay-bot: rb-20260222-001 status=running. progress=12%
data-ryan: While running, I'm computing expected token delta with this ledger query to compare after replay:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing_ledger
WHERE account_id = 'ACME' AND usage_day = '2026-02-22';
```
Current ledger sum for 2026-02-22 = 720305 tokens (matches invoice). Dashboard export = 1,198,643 tokens. Expect ~478k tokens to reappear.
replay-bot: rb-20260222-001 status=failed. error="write to processed topic: proto mismatch on message 4231"
devin: Hmm, failure on a batch with a deeply nested v2 payload we didn't catch in unit tests. I'm rerunning with a fallback transform that does a defensive flattening and logs problematic ids. New command same as above + `--retry 2`.
replay-bot: rb-20260222-001 retry=1 status=running
replay-bot: rb-20260222-001 status=success. processed=1,205,212 events. duration=00:22:41
data-ryan: OK re-run finished. Now computing ledger delta.
(10m pass)
data-ryan: Post-replay ledger query result: sum(tokens) = 1,198,900 for 2026-02-22. Delta vs invoice = +478,595 tokens. Close to dashboard export.
dina-billing: Confirmed. We should issue a credit for the difference on ACME's March invoice and send an explanation. Dev: can you produce an audit list of event IDs that were replayed for ACME between 02:00-03:30?
devin: Generated and uploaded CSV to secure share: s3://replay-audit/ACME/2026-02-22-replayed-ids.csv (ACL internal). Includes token counts per event + transform notes.
maria: Draft customer note: apology, root cause (event consumer OOM + proto compatibility bug), what we did (compat transform + controlled backfill), numbers (delta ~478.6k tokens), and credit applied. Lina from AE will send.
dina-billing: Credit amount calc: billing unit price = $0.0006/token -> credit = 478,595 * 0.0006 = $287.16. I'll add rounding and ledger adj entry.
support-liz: ACME confirmed receipt of explanation and appreciated the quick follow-up. They asked for a short post-mortem doc.
sre-jordan: I'll own a short post-mortem describing root cause, why replay didn't tolerate v2, and remediation: add compatibility layer and enhance replay-tool e2e test with v2 payload fixtures.
devin: Added tests and a replay-tool flag `--schema-strict=false` for emergency runs. We'll also schedule a one-time reconciliation job to scan last 30 days for similar gaps and surface candidates.
maria: Thanks all. Closing loop: job id rb-20260222-001 succeeded on retry; ledger updated; billing credit initiated; PM will send post-mortem + action items.
dina-billing: I'll create invoice adjustment record and route for approvals.
replay-bot: rb-20260222-001 final_status=success. artifacts: s3://replay-artifacts/rb-20260222-001/logs.tar.gz
maria: Marking this thread resolved unless new issues pop up. :white_check_mark:
